fields.subject: SQL Server Provider Package
fields.where: ArgentSea.Sql.csproj sets GeneratePackageOnBuild to true, IncludeSymbols to true and SymbolPackageFormat to snupkg
fields.response: pack the ArgentSea.Sql NuGet package (with a package version that moves independently of its assembly and file version, MIT licence expression, packing readme.md and argentsea-logo.png at the package root as its readme and icon) together with a separate .snupkg symbol package rather than embedding debugging symbols in the main package
fields.postcondition: every build of the SQL Server database provider yields a publishable package and its companion symbol package without a separate pack step

evidenceLinks.note: PackageInvariantTests pass against the 2.1.0 project files at commit ea8e9aa3 (ArgentSea.Test 623/623).
